category_summary:
### Executive Signal
- **Agent infrastructure is consolidating** across orchestration runtimes, skills frameworks, and IDE-integrated coding agents, signaling that the agent stack is moving from experimentation to platformization.

### Priority Developments
- **Multi-vendor orchestration runtimes are emerging as the agent control plane.** [google/ax](/?date=2026-09-24&category=github_trending#item-9c59b80fdafa), [agent-substrate/substrate](/?date=2026-09-24&category=github_trending#item-801aee87ebd4), and [obra/superpowers](/?date=2026-09-24&category=github_trending#item-f49502979215) together indicate a battle for the standard runtime layer above LLMs.
- **Vertical office and document agents are productizing rapidly.** [dream-num/univer](/?date=2026-09-24&category=github_trending#item-2be98cd199e8) and [anthropics/financial-services](/?date=2026-09-24&category=github_trending#item-9a0f41e62a8b) show domain-specific agents targeting spreadsheets, docs, and regulated workflows with enterprise-ready scope.
- **A "tool router" abstraction layer is forming around agent capabilities.** superdesigndev/treg positions as OpenRouter for agent tools, while [browser-use/video-use](/?date=2026-09-24&category=github_trending#item-c59dff5a9a86) expands agents into media editing, widening the addressable surface.
- **IDE-integrated coding agents are commoditizing fast.** [can1357/oh-my-pi](/?date=2026-09-24&category=github_trending#item-b24b10a0ae94) and [davila7/claude-code-templates](/?date=2026-09-24&category=github_trending#item-dd642593e644) suggest coding-assistant differentiation is shifting from model to developer-experience and template ecosystems.

### Leadership Implications
- **Re-evaluate the build-vs-buy posture on agent orchestration and tooling layers** within 90 days, as open-source alternatives are reaching production-grade maturity.
- **Establish an internal agent governance framework now**, before vertical agents (docs, finance, media) proliferate unmanaged across business units.
